system.description: A nail of Khael's petrified blood, prised from the oldest shrine of the Obsidian Bastion. It is warm, and glows faintly when struck. Once per day, as ◈◈, hammer it into a door, gate or wall: nothing weaker than a Mighty foe can open or break through until a new day begins. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◈◈ Drive it into the ground and speak Khael's name: for 1 hour, nothing that is not of flesh and blood (Duskborn, undead, Shades, constructs, elementals) can enter a 30' circle around it.
system.drawback: The Fabricators of the Sacred Gear count every vein of Godstone. They know it is gone, and they send someone to ask you where.
system.faction: the Fabricators of the Sacred Gear
